goal: Administrator authentication and customer authentication operate as separate identities, and each login surface displays the approved VII logo reliably.

intent_model.literal_request: Separate admin access from customer access, keep /admin unrelated to the customer account, and fix the missing login logo.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Two independent, secure and visually branded login flows that can coexist without leaking session state or sending administrators through customer screens.
likely_rejections: Only the wording changed while both roles still share one cookie.
Admin logout clears the customer account or redirects to /account.
The logo file exists but still flashes broken in the actual dialog.
One role can still authorize the other role's route or API.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Separate storage, authorization, entry, failure and logout boundaries, not merely visual labels.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The person sees either a clearly branded customer login or a clearly branded administrator login, never both.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose the Google account for the role-specific flow.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Return to the requested customer page or authorized administrator destination.
deferred_complexity: permission management after administrator identity is established
preserved_depth: customer profile and form autofill remains available
authenticated guest review submission remains available
administrator permission audit records remain available
customer and administrator logout remain independent

natural_destination: Public customer sign-in dialog and /admin administrator sign-in flow

facts.claim: Current code uses the same vii_session cookie for public account APIs and administrator authorization.
The public AccountAccessProvider currently wraps admin routes.
The approved logo asset exists and returns a valid PNG publicly.

assumptions.claim: The broken logo state is caused by on-demand modal loading rather than a missing or corrupt asset.
assumptions.validation: Compare direct asset decode with cold and warm modal rendering after preload/eager loading.

in_scope: distinct customer and administrator session cookies
distinct OAuth nonce and callback audience handling
dedicated administrator login and logout/session APIs
public account provider excluded from admin routes
approved VII logo preloaded and rendered eagerly on both login surfaces
regression tests for role boundaries and public account features
invariants: Existing admin module permissions remain unchanged.
Public customer profile, review and autofill behavior remains available.
Analytics continues to classify a real admin session as internal traffic.
The approved VII logo asset and brand copy remain unchanged.
affected_family: Google OAuth start and signed callback state
customer and administrator HttpOnly session cookies
desktop customer and administrator login surfaces
mobile customer and administrator login surfaces

requirements.statement: Customer and administrator sessions are stored and authorized independently.
Every administrator entry, failure and logout remains in the administrator flow.
The approved VII logo displays without a broken-image state on both login surfaces.
requirements.source: User screenshot and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: Existing public customer and administrator capabilities outside the separation remain intact.

acceptance_checks.setup: Only a customer session cookie exists.
acceptance_checks.action: Open an administrator page and API.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The admin flow requests administrator authentication and the API denies access.

acceptance_checks.setup: Only an administrator session cookie exists.
acceptance_checks.action: Read the public customer session API and public account state.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No customer account is returned or persisted.

acceptance_checks.setup: Administrator OAuth is cancelled, invalid or forbidden.
acceptance_checks.action: Return from Google or fail authorization.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A dedicated administrator login/error surface appears, not /account.

acceptance_checks.setup: An invalid, expired or cross-audience OAuth state reaches the callback.
acceptance_checks.action: The callback validates its signed audience and nonce.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No session cookie is created and the correct role-specific error surface is shown.

acceptance_checks.action: Log out from one role and reload both surfaces.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Only the selected role is logged out; the other role remains unchanged.

acceptance_checks.setup: Cold and warm desktop and mobile page loads.
acceptance_checks.action: Open customer and administrator login surfaces.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The exact approved VII logo is decoded and visible with no broken placeholder.

acceptance_checks.action: Run focused authentication tests, the related regression suite and a production build.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Customer profile/review/autofill and admin permission tests pass without changing permission rules.

acceptance_checks.action: Record the exact baseline and candidate identities.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One-step rollback to v657 remains available before any authorized publication.
